results.title: Imagine Dragons - Believer (2017)
results.description:
A monster hit for this US band three years ago and ever since, although it peaked at #4 rather than #1 for some reason. Definitely one of the better songs of the 2010's. When I 
first heard it a few years ago I knew I wanted to do something with it. I had considered using some dance bits from "Rapture" by Blondie for parts of the video, but decided against it and temporarily scrapped the project. I was thinking about putting together a video featuring a jazz track from John McLaughlin's Extrapolation album when I came across a clip from a film I saw over ten years ago and not again since. Because of the destruction of the statue of all statues in the action scenes, both the song "Believer" and the still ongoing riots in US cities and possibly even more violent revolution next year took on a new meaning. The video may be a bit over the top, but it serves as a sufficient warning.
